Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at NII?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow (Project) position at the National Institute of Immunology is 11 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this NII recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Masters Degree in Biochemistry, Immunology, Biotechnology, Life Science, or related fields. A NET-JRF or equivalent national-level fellowship is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. How much is the salary for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month, plus 30% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 100 for General/OBC candidates. Women and SC/ST/PH candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Junior Research Fellow (Project) post?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email to the project investigator. You need to send your Curriculum Vitae along with the names of three referees.

faq.question: Q6. What documents are required with the application?
faq.answer: Your Curriculum Vitae should include details of your experimental expertise and a list of publications. You will also need to provide documentary proof for fee exemption if applicable.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial shortlisting of candidates, followed by an interview which may be conducted in offline or online mode.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an age limit. Candidates are advised to refer to the official advertisement for any age-related details.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from all over India apply?
faq.answer: Yes, the job is advertised as being available across India, with the city of recruitment being Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (Project) position at the National Institute of Immunology.
